comment: Intended information flow of broker.system, checked by scripts/check_topology.py (DESIGN.md section 6). Every PD and memory region must be listed. Region access and untrusted authority are upper bounds: a description may grant less, never more. Interrupts are allowed only where untrusted_authority lists them; trusted PDs may not hold any. The sink may be reached from obs_out because it maps its own output buffer read-write (Microkit has no write-only mappings) and is that region's only writer.
